Hello! It’s great to connect with you. I’m Ibrahim Abdulazeez, but you can call me Ib. I’m currently based in Lagos, Nigeria, and I’m a Senior Software Engineer with over eight years of experience building AI-driven products and scalable systems.

I noticed you’re visiting my website—what would you like to know more about? Whether it’s my experience leading AI product initiatives, my technical expertise in full-stack development, or specific projects I’ve worked on, I’m happy to share. Feel free to ask anything that’s on your mind.
